description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0 (latest LTS)

tasks.description: Upgrade eShopOnWeb from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 (latest LTS) across all source and test projects
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. The project currently targets net8.0 with SDK 8.0.x. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS, offering a longer support window, performance improvements, and access to the newest platform APIs. Upgrading ensures the solution remains on a modern, actively supported runtime.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution (Web, PublicApi, ApplicationCore, Infrastructure, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, and all test projects) from net8.0 to net10.0. This includes updating the TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props and any individual project files, updating the SDK version in global.json to 10.0.x, updating all NuGet package versions (Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Microsoft.Extensions.*, Blazor packages, and other dependencies) to versions compatible with .NET 10, and resolving any API breaking changes introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10. All projects must build successfully and all tests must pass after the upgrade.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded eShopOnWeb to .NET 10 by updating the SDK, target framework, package/workflow compatibility, and required build/test compatibility fixes; full solution build and tests passed on net10.0.
